_comment: Single source of truth for teacher-APPROVED rubric versions. Contains exactly one approval: DOK rubric v0.2, approved_at 2026-07-20T19:06:13-04:00 (RC approval, recorded 2026-07-20). Add an entry {version, approved_at ISO-8601} to 'approvals' ONLY upon a real teacher approval -- this tool never writes to this file; a human edits it by hand. Entries recorded (recorded_at) before a version's approved_at NEVER verify under that version -- there is no retroactive verification.
